packages.title: IndexCore extraction, Host interface, AppServices, extension timers
packages.description:
ADR 0005 §2.2, §3.1, §3.3.

- **IndexCore.** Move the IndexDO body (index-do.ts:276-600) into `IndexCore(config, host: Host, extensions: CoreExtension[])`. `Host` is `{db, alarm, extensionAlarm, connectJetstream, transport, backup?, log, clock, random}`. index-do.ts becomes a thin wrapper that builds a Workers Host and delegates, so the workerd suites keep passing.
- **IndexRpc** (contracts.ts) gains `adminBackup()`. `adminPitr` stays until N6-02, and a host without a backup or PITR port answers `not_supported`.
- **AppServices** (worker/src/app/services.ts) is an empty interface that features extend by declaration merging.
- **Timers** (timers.ts): `TIMER_NAMES` gains outbox, forward, import, oauth-keepalive, expiry-sweep and backup. A name with no handler is never armed. A throwing handler is re-armed with backoff.
- **Two lanes (ADR §3.3).** `runDue(storage, db, handlers, {names})` and `armAlarm(storage, db, {names})` take a names subset. The single-flight guard stays keyed on the storage object, so IndexCore drives the core names from `Host.alarm` and the extension names, in the fixed order above, from `Host.extensionAlarm`; neither lane waits for the other.
- **AlarmStorage** becomes the structural `{setAlarm(ms), deleteAlarm()}` type, so timers.ts no longer needs @cloudflare/workers-types (N6-02 then does not touch it).
- **worker/test/harness/local-index.ts:** METHODS gains `adminBackup` (it is `Record<keyof IndexRpc, true>`, so tsc -b would fail without it). N6-02 removes `adminPitr` from it.

packages.title: Pinned outbound transport (DNS-answer checks at connect time)
packages.description:
ADR 0005 §3.5.

The transport lives in worker/src/node/ (ADR §3.5): @atmusic/atproto is Workers- and browser-safe with no Node built-ins and declares no undici, while worker-node already has Node types and N0-01 pins undici in worker/package.json.

`pinnedTransport({lookup?, caps})` returns a Transport over an undici Agent whose `connect.lookup` applies `isAllowedAddress` (net/url-policy.ts) to every answer and connects only to the checked address. The existing SafeFetch policy wraps it unchanged. Failures are `TransportError {code: 'blocked_address'|'dns'|'connect'|'timeout'|'too_large'|'redirect'}`, never a raw TypeError.

The DoH HTTP pre-check is not used on this path; net/doh.ts stays for handle TXT. Tests inject the lookup function. No real DNS and no real network.

packages.title: Crypto primitives: AES-GCM box with HKDF, tokens, constant-time compare, MD5
packages.description:
ADR 0005 §3.8, §5.5, §13.

- **box.ts:** `seal(purpose, plaintext, aad)` / `open(...)`. AES-256-GCM with keys from HKDF-SHA256 over `encryptionKeys`, using the salts and infos of §3.8, which are Rust-compatible for OAuth. Format `keyId‖nonce‖ct‖tag`. Typed BoxError. Rotation is open with any key and seal with keys[0]. AAD per purpose (ADR §3.8): the state key hash, the DID, `linked/<did>/<service>` and `lastfm-app/<api_key>/<did>`.
- **tokens.ts:** random 32-byte hex session tokens, 32-hex Last.fm tokens and session keys, UUIDv4 ListenBrainz tokens, 24-character base32 app passwords; `hashToken` = SHA-256. All take an injected Random.
- **constant-time.ts:** a portable digest compare.
- **md5.ts:** node:crypto MD5 hex.

packages.title: Node composition: main, dispatch, shutdown, systemd notify, admin socket, backups, bundle and guard
packages.description:
ADR 0005 §3.1, §3.7, §3.9–§3.11, §14.5.

- **compose(config, secrets, {transport, connectJetstream, features})** builds the Node Host and IndexCore, then the dispatcher: router prefixes /api/, /health/, /oauth/, /2.0, /1/ and /audioscrobbler/, then static files, then assetMiss. router.ts exports assetMiss and its route table; matchRoute gains the widened method union, HEAD→GET and the 405 Allow answer below, and is otherwise unchanged.
- **RequestCtx** (http/types.ts) gains optional `deps?`, `app?` and `peer?` (clientIp stays), so the RequestCtx literals in seven N2-02 test files keep compiling; compose always sets them and handlers read them through `need(ctx, key)`, which throws CtxWiringError (500). `env` becomes `AppEnv = Pick<EnvVars, 'LEXICON_PREFIX' | 'NAMESPACE_OWNERSHIP_REF'> & {ADMIN_TOKEN?: string}`, to which the Workers Env is assignable.
- **RouteDef.method** widens to GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE | OPTIONS; dispatch maps HEAD to GET without a body and answers 405 with Allow for another method on a matched path (wave-3 routes need PUT, PATCH, DELETE and OPTIONS).
- **Dispatch extras:** `/internal/` on TCP is the JSON 404 before routing; `GET /` with `hs=true` reaches the router (§7.10); request logs carry the route pattern and never a query string or body on any route, logging only an allowlisted Last.fm method name (§3.10, §13).
- **admin.ts:** adds the admin-socket routes (status with backup age, queue depths and upload-directory size; backup; resnapshot; oauth prune-kid) using the portable constant-time compare. The existing Workers TCP admin route and ADMIN_TOKEN stay in ROUTES for the Workers entry and composition/admin.test.ts until N3-07 ports that suite; N6-02 deletes them. Node never reaches them (the /internal/ 404 above).
- **main.ts:** the §3.10 startup order and the readiness probes: open the database first (exclusive lock; exit 75 database_locked when held elsewhere; exit 78 for a missing file without `--init`), then the admin socket, then the pre-migration backup and migration under EXTEND_TIMEOUT_USEC, then listen and READY=1. `--version` prints the build-time git sha. Exit 78 for configuration, 75 for a locked database.
- **shutdown.ts:** the SIGTERM drain.
- **systemd.ts:** READY=1, STOPPING=1 and WATCHDOG=1 through an injectable systemd-notify spawner.
- **backup.ts:** node:sqlite async `backup(db, tmp, {rate})` (never VACUUM INTO on the main thread), `PRAGMA integrity_check` in a worker_thread on a read-only connection to the copy, rename and fsync, backup_runs with kind, retention 7 daily and 4 weekly over daily and manual runs only (pre-migration and pre-restore copies are never pruned), the pre-migration backup, and the `backup` extension timer.
- **build-server.ts:** the esbuild bundle worker/dist/node/main.mjs, with `--check` (build, then run `--check-config` against a test config), the git sha embedded for `--version`, and `--e2e [--entry <path>]`, which builds the separate worker/dist/node/e2e.mjs from worker/test/e2e/node-entry.ts (N6-01) and exits 2 when the entry does not exist. Both builds write esbuild metafiles.
- **check-bundle.ts:** rewritten as the Node guard of §3.9. It prints the git sha and the bundle SHA-256. It also asserts that main.mjs has no fixture-host mapping, no fixtureOrigins option, no `fixture: true` url-policy option and no http-origin allowance, and, when e2e.mjs exists, that every worker/src and packages/*/src input of main.mjs is an input of e2e.mjs with the same content hash and that e2e.mjs adds only worker/test/e2e and test-support inputs.

packages.title: Imports: Last.fm and ListenBrainz sources, uploads, ZIP bounds, staging, dedupe, writer, routes
packages.description:
ADR 0005 §11.

**Job states:** waiting_index → fetching → writing → done, plus paused, failed and cancelled. Driven by the `import` extension timer.

**Sources:**
- Last.fm backward paging (fixed `to`, boundary dedupe, progress guarantee, nowplaying skip, sk when linked). It uses the shared upstream pacing from N3-08 through an injected `Pacer` interface defined here, so the two packages share no file.
- ListenBrainz max_ts paging.
- Uploads (64 MiB, streamed to disk at 0600, 507 past ATMUSIC_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES or below ATMUSIC_MIN_FREE_BYTES; deleted once parsed or when the job is cancelled or fails; a startup sweep removes orphans). Parsing is streaming only (ADR §11.1): fflate Unzip with UnzipInflate, line-by-line JSONL, a page-splitting tokenizer for the Last.fm JSON export, and bomb bounds on actual inflated bytes (64 MiB per entry, 256 MiB total).
- ListenBrainz feedback.jsonl resolution against the archive listens (recording_msid, then recording_mbid via mbid_mapping or additional_info), after all listens entries.

**Pipeline:**
- staging with listen-key dedupe;
- the writer creating import-priority operations in slices of 1,000;
- feedback score 1 → love.put operations with origin import, scores 0 and -1 skipped, unresolved rows invalid with reason feedback_unresolved;
- the crash-loop guard: import_jobs.attempts incremented and committed before each slice, reset on completion, failed with crash_loop at 3;
- admission: a waiting_index job whose DID has no users row retries `admit(…, 'notify', …)` on each import timer run with backoff (ADR §11.2).
- staging rows deleted 7 days after done.

**Routes:** POST imports, POST imports/upload, GET list and detail with ETA, cancel, resume.
